note: He misses hard on the two headline criteria. Occupation was never asked, but what surfaced — working with youth and coworkers in a setting that provides his breakfast and lunch five days a week — is not the business owner or physician the stated ICP describes, and his own self-assessment is 'I pay my bills, I go to work, I do all that I need to do.' Income is a clear miss with a number attached: $500 to $700 a month capacity, a stated cap of $600, no credit-card use on principle, and confirmation that paying even the three-month tier up front would impact him. He matches on neglected health, which is squarely his own framing, and on good-to-great — this is not a rescue case, it is a man who says 'the average isn't who I want to be' and is reaching for a higher standard rather than escaping a crisis. Not_deconditioned cannot be assessed and is deliberately left out of both lists: no height, weight, body composition, current training or physical limitation was ever established on this call, so there is no basis to judge the exclusion criterion either way. That absence is itself the finding — the rep reached a close attempt on a body-composition programme without a single data point about the prospect's body.
